main_body: Iron lamp post: a domed cap over a glowing lantern box, a thin pole, and a domed base. Judged on the cap and lantern as the largest volume.
top_band: Light grey dome/ellipse top with a yellow highlight, rows ~2-7, then a darker grey underside band at rows 8-9
evidence: Reading down the centre column: a light grey elliptical cap about 6 rows tall (rows 2-7), then a dark underside at rows 8-9 that works as an eave shadow. Below it is the lantern front (rows ~11-17) with orange panes set into a dark frame. The base at rows 36-40 repeats the same pattern, with a lighter dome top and a dark front below. The cap reads as a surface seen from above rather than a thin rim, so the column top is visible. The thin pole is just a detail.

style.evidence: The grey ramp has about 4 steps on the cap and base. The outline is a dark blue-grey that is close to neutral near-black in places. The pole is a flat 2-tone strip and the cap and base dome sides are flat fills with no grain or dot texture. Each tile carries only a few colours, well below the references' stall awnings and well stonework, which have per-tile highlights and many more colours. It looks thinner and more sticker-like beside them.
